Privacy policy

Cookies, traffic metrics, advertising and third-party services on SmartHome-AI.

Álvaro Menezes · Published: 2026-10-09 · Updated: 2026-10-20 · 4 min read

In this guide

  • Browsing and local preferences
  • Hosting and security
  • Traffic metrics
  • Advertising
  • Links and contact
  • Requests and updates

This policy applies to smarthome-ai.com. The site is operated by Álvaro Menezes. For privacy questions, contact alvaroajm@gmail.com.

Browsing and local preferences#

The site provides public guides without reader registration. Your theme preference and the lighting demonstration state are stored locally in your browser. The demonstration does not control real devices or send your home configuration to the site. You can clear these preferences through your browser's site-data settings.

Hosting and security#

The site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. To deliver pages and protect the service, Cloudflare may process technical connection data, such as IP address, browser, requested page and time. See Cloudflare's Privacy policy for this provider's practices.

Traffic metrics#

The site uses Google Analytics 4 to measure visits and understand which guides are used. The service may use cookies and browser identifiers and receive information about page views, interactions, device and traffic source. These metrics help improve content and navigation. See how Google uses data from partner sites and apps.

Advertising#

SmartHome-AI includes Google AdSense integration. Ad display depends on Google's approval and the site's account settings; the presence of ad code does not mean the site has been approved.

When advertising features load, third parties, including Google and its partners, may set and read cookies, use pixels or web beacons, and process IP addresses and other identifiers to deliver ads, measure performance and prevent fraud. Advertising cookies may enable personalized ads based on previous visits to this site or other sites.

In particular, Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve ads on this site. Google's use of the DoubleClick cookie (IDE, set by doubleclick.net) enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this site and other sites on the internet.

You can opt out of the DoubleClick cookie for interest-based advertising in Google Ads Settings or adjust personalization in Google's My Ad Center. For choices offered by other participating providers, see YourAdChoices. You can also block or delete cookies through your browser settings. These choices do not necessarily stop all advertisements from appearing.

Links and contact#

Links to manufacturers, projects, social networks, WhatsApp and other sites lead to services with their own policies. If you contact us, the content and details you send will be processed by the chosen service and the site operator to respond to your request. Avoid sending passwords, access codes or unnecessary personal information.

Requests and updates#

To ask questions or exercise rights concerning data under the site's responsibility, use the contact above. Data held by third parties may also require a request directly to that provider. This policy will be updated when the services and uses described here change.

Updated on October 20, 2026.
